newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Insurance Council of Australia names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Insurance Council of Australia names new CEO.

text.p: The Insurance Council of Australia said on Friday it had appointed Alan Mason as chief executive to replace Peter Daly who retires in January 1997.
Mason is presently the managing director of LawCover Pty Ltd and has held a variety of senior positions in the Australian insurance industry.
"Mr Mason will contine the Council's vigorous drive to represent the insurance industry's interests to the political, legislative, business and general communities," the Council said in a statement.
The Insurance Council of Australia is the major representative body for the general insurance industry in Australia and has a total membership of 120 companies.
